answer: Require every agent to lock a time-delayed stake that thaws like a glacier: capital is committed up front and released only slowly, so it cannot be recycled between fake identities. Each verified identity gets one marble in a shared registry, earned by completing real work from a mesa of zero trust. An attacker minting thousands of sybils must fund a separate locked stake for each one, and fresh marbles carry no reputation until they build an honest history. Volume of identities stops mattering — only aged, proven marbles can transact at scale.
